author: deme1744
content:
<@372731338031366165> I made a comment on the eth-clients bootstrap node PR, but thought I'd ping you here as it already got merged and might go unnoticed: https://github.com/eth-clients/mainnet/pull/15#discussion_r4045077880

Basically, I would prefer not to see ENRs go in the enode.yaml files. It is not clean in general but even less so due to the fact that in the near future we want to stop using discv4 and enodes.

author: mysticryuujin
content: I put up PRs to remove the enr records from the enodes.yaml - the same nodes already exist as enode records, so it's just a removal

author: deme1744
content: I would be in favor of adding those ENRs in `metadata/bootstrap_nodes.yaml`, not sure what other teams think about that of course.

author: deme1744
content: I don't see why we still need to make the split between EL and CL bootstrap nodes once discv4/enode goes away. As there is no actual protocol/network difference between those.
